requirements.summary: Keep core policy independent of Minecraft/provider implementations without claiming demonstrated portability
requirements.source: User requested a reusable platform with Minecraft as first body
requirements.acceptance: Core imports no Mineflayer/OpenAI/SQLite implementation; fakes prove boundaries, not world portability.

requirements.summary: Connect one stable named NPC to the empirically selected private Paper world
requirements.acceptance: The same AgentId completes join, player-detection, disconnect, reconnect, and restart smoke gates using a dated compatibility record.

requirements.summary: Produce a limited structured agent-scoped nearby perception
requirements.acceptance: Only typed self, authorized-player, addressed-chat, bounded entity, position, connection, and behavior evidence enters core; suppressed observations carry reasons.

requirements.summary: Hold an in-character conversation through one runtime-owned utterance-delivery path
requirements.acceptance: One accepted addressed chat yields at most one player-visible submission attempt for its UtteranceId; unconfirmed delivery is unknown and is not retried.

requirements.summary: Expose only typed validated Gate-A action and control capabilities
requirements.acceptance: Gate A permits follow_player and stop_behavior plus emergency stop; no speech, raw commands, item mutation, building, crafting, or combat enters the physical action union.

requirements.summary: Preserve causal conversation-to-action-to-evidence linkage
requirements.acceptance: The acceptance request, model decision, ActionId, BehaviorId, behavior events, and capability-appropriate evidence share one causal chain; started is never success.

requirements.summary: Persist event-grounded continuity across full shutdown and restart
requirements.acceptance: Complete source events and one deterministic encounter survive restart and naturally affect later dialogue or behavior.

requirements.summary: Separate world facts, bounded observations, subjective beliefs, source events, and model interpretations
requirements.acceptance: Contracts and context label every epistemic category; a summary cannot replace or prove its source event.

requirements.summary: Represent dispatch, activity, completion, failure, interruption, cancellation, timeout, and uncertainty honestly
requirements.acceptance: Fault tests distinguish all states and never generalize movement evidence to authoritative mutation.

requirements.summary: Suspend cognition and embodiment while the authorized player is absent without disconnecting a healthy client
requirements.acceptance: Absence enters SUSPENDED, cancels cognition and behavior, retains only presence/connection/safety control, makes zero model calls, and resumes only after observed return.

requirements.summary: Use deterministic trigger, safety, presence, queue, and behavior logic
requirements.acceptance: Ambient events and routine movement make zero model calls; only Gate-A designated stimuli enqueue cognition.

requirements.summary: Scale through a two-agent gate toward 8-10 separate characters
requirements.acceptance: After Gate A, two-agent isolation passes before any 8-10-character load claim.

requirements.summary: Enforce per-character knowledge and memory visibility boundaries
requirements.acceptance: Post-proof two-agent fixtures prove private records do not cross without an explicit transmission event.

requirements.summary: Maintain separate relationship belief goal intention and plan state per character
requirements.acceptance: Post-proof schemas and behavior tests demonstrate independent, directional, versioned state.

requirements.summary: Emit a minimal causal evidence trail across the Gate-A loop
requirements.acceptance: An export joins principal/world/epoch/event/conversation/model/utterance/action/behavior/evidence IDs with redaction.

requirements.summary: Provide owner-safe local diagnosis stop backup restore reset and evidence commands
requirements.source: Operator control necessity surfaced by architect
requirements.acceptance: Package scripts emit PASS/WARN/FAIL and perform safeguarded local operations; authenticated service and corrections remain deferred.

requirements.summary: Provide minimal Gate-A migration integrity and safe backup/restore
requirements.source: Persistence operations necessity surfaced by architect
requirements.acceptance: Empty, repeat, backup, separate-path restore, integrity, and safeguarded reset checks pass; governance/deletion breadth is deferred.

requirements.summary: Recover predictably from model adapter process restart and stale-behavior failures
requirements.acceptance: Recovery tests yield typed interruption/unknown/reconciliation outcomes and never claim a disconnected client detects player return.

requirements.summary: Maintain evidence-based resumption and bounded IDE-agent micro-steps
requirements.acceptance: Every active package has exact files, prompt, commands, output, pass/fail, recovery, stop condition, and checkpoint evidence.

requirements.summary: Add authoritative item and inventory mutations only after the defining proof
requirements.source: User requested safe physical action breadth
requirements.acceptance: Post-proof capability-specific ownership, transfer, crash, and reconciliation tests pass.

requirements.summary: Preserve an optional safe seam for LSL-inspired action tags or emotes
requirements.acceptance: Any future notation is threat-modeled and compiles to existing typed capability/control boundaries without becoming a script executor.

requirements.summary: Meet coherent Gate-A cognition response dispatch and control budgets
requirements.acceptance: Canonical LIM-GA-001 through LIM-GA-007 separate outer response, model, dispatch, utterance, behavior, reevaluation, and priority-control budgets; the semantic guard verifies their required relationships.

requirements.summary: Bound 8-10-agent concurrency and idle model calls
requirements.acceptance: Post-proof capacity limits are set from measured two-agent behavior before ten-agent testing.

requirements.summary: Enforce multi-level model cost and concurrency budgets
requirements.acceptance: Post-proof run/session/daily budgets pass deterministic exhaustion tests; Gate A uses one timeout, stimulus suppression, and provider-side spend protection.

requirements.summary: Meet Gate-A durability shutdown restart and restore targets
requirements.source: Operational quality necessity surfaced by architect
requirements.acceptance: Committed events survive full stop, safety control precedes the LIM-GA-013 shutdown deadline, and a verified backup restores to a separate path.

requirements.summary: Prevent secret private-context command-channel and accidental network exposure
requirements.source: Security and privacy necessity surfaced by architect
requirements.acceptance: Checks find no credentials in logs/prompts/data, no slash-command route, and no unapproved public listener.

requirements.summary: Keep the default automated suite deterministic and network-free
requirements.acceptance: Default tests pass twice with fakes, network denied, and zero live world/model calls.

requirements.summary: Demonstrate portability only with a second materially different real environment adapter
requirements.acceptance: No portability claim appears before the second real adapter passes revised conformance without freezing Minecraft-shaped abstractions.

requirements.summary: Suppress uncontrolled Gate-A cognition stimuli
requirements.acceptance: Only addressed authorized-player chat and designated result/restart events trigger; overflow/coalescing/suspension reasons are observable; absence produces zero calls.

requirements.summary: Promote only deterministic Gate-A encounters
requirements.acceptance: Promotion occurs only on an explicit remember request or the designated acceptance interaction that caused the demonstrated action.

requirements.summary: Pass Gate A through the LIM-GA-014 consecutive machine-evidenced live repetitions and owner experiential approval
requirements.acceptance: The LIM-GA-014 consecutive full meet-act-suspend-stop-restart-recall runs pass, and the owner records that the live character is worth continuing.

requirements.summary: Use stable internal principal world epoch and causal identities
requirements.acceptance: Authorization, participants, memory, action ownership, and restart records use internal IDs; Minecraft aliases map to PrincipalId; incompatible reset increments WorldEpoch.

invariants.summary: Paper/Minecraft is authority for physical state; Mineflayer is an observation and command channel
invariants.source: Agent-world profile and user belief/truth requirement
invariants.enforcement: Typed observation/evidence contracts and restart reconciliation

invariants.summary: Model narration and utterance text cannot mutate physical state
invariants.enforcement: Separate UtteranceProposal and ActionRequest unions; no narration executor

invariants.summary: Action status advances only on the minimum environment-derived evidence required by that capability
invariants.enforcement: CapabilityEvidence union and per-capability evidence threshold table

invariants.summary: Every model run belongs to exactly one agent and scoped context
invariants.enforcement: Per-agent actor, runtime-issued IDs, context schema

invariants.summary: Private knowledge crosses agents only through explicit transmission
invariants.enforcement: Viewer-aware visibility queries and source provenance

invariants.summary: One agent has at most one exclusive long-running physical behavior lease
invariants.enforcement: BehaviorId lease and high-priority control path

invariants.summary: Duplicate event utterance action and behavior IDs cannot duplicate records or effects
invariants.enforcement: Stable IDs, unique keys, one utterance attempt, idempotent lookup, and non-blind retry

invariants.summary: Gate-A schema changes are ordered transactional and recorded; broad migration governance is deferred
invariants.enforcement: Minimal migration ledger/checksum and WRK-004 tests

invariants.summary: Models receive no raw commands code filesystem credentials or open network
invariants.enforcement: Closed tool catalogue, no sandbox tools, dependency checks

invariants.summary: Agent Principal World and WorldEpoch identities remain stable across transport sessions
invariants.enforcement: Internal IDs and explicit alias/epoch mapping

invariants.summary: SUSPENDED overrides every cognition trigger and permits no model call or physical behavior
invariants.enforcement: Availability gate, abort signals, priority stop, and suppression telemetry

invariants.summary: Dependency health is independent of agent connection and availability state
invariants.enforcement: Four health axes; DEGRADED is never an exclusive lifecycle state

invariants.summary: Derived interpretations require visible source-event provenance or are rejected; provenance does not prove faithfulness
invariants.enforcement: Foreign-key/source visibility checks, source retention, contradiction and continuity fixtures

invariants.summary: Comprehensive operator correction is deferred and may never falsify physical state
invariants.enforcement: Future typed correction ADR and audit; no generic Gate-A replacement contract

invariants.summary: World portability is not demonstrated until a second materially different real adapter passes a revised suite
invariants.enforcement: WRK-014 gate; Gate A uses boundary fakes only

invariants.summary: The runtime has exactly one player-visible utterance validation and submission owner
invariants.enforcement: CMP-003 plus INT-011; no speak action, finalSpeech, tool callback, or blind retry

invariants.summary: The actor serializes decisions and state mutation but never waits for physical behavior duration
invariants.enforcement: Immediate dispatch result and later BehaviorEvent stream

invariants.summary: No runtime means no subjective elapsed time or invented offline event
invariants.enforcement: Restart gap marker and explicit unknown interval

decisions.summary: Use a Minecraft-first modular monolith with revisable provider/environment seams
consequences: Fast local proof and explicit boundaries
Fakes test contracts but do not prove world portability
Minecraft-shaped assumptions remain revisable until a second real adapter

decisions.summary: Empirically select and pin the newest smoke-tested stable Paper/Mineflayer/pathfinder/Java/Node intersection
alternatives: Follow latest dependencies without a record
consequences: SPIKE-000 and WRK-002 gate all embodiment work
Exact versions are evidence, not architectural commitments
Fallback to another verified intersection needs no architecture review

decisions.summary: Use strict TypeScript on an empirically pinned Node LTS with npm Zod and Vitest
decisions.source: Both selected primary adapters are TypeScript-first
consequences: One runtime and shared schemas
WRK-002 pins Node before WRK-004 storage work
No native SQLite binding may be selected implicitly

decisions.summary: Keep provider-neutral ModelPort and use the simplest supported OpenAI structured-output adapter for Gate A
decisions.source: Revision 2 provider resolution; primary OpenAI sources re-read 2026-07-17
alternatives: Agents SDK adapter when it materially simplifies Gate A
consequences: One ModelDecision schema leaves core provider-neutral
Agents SDK is optional and non-permanent
Model alias and adapter versions live in the dated compatibility record

decisions.summary: Use SQLite WAL after Node is pinned; prefer verified node:sqlite and use named native fallback only if its Gate-A probes fail
alternatives: better-sqlite3 with Python 3 and Visual Studio C++ Build Tools
PostgreSQL or vector database from start
consequences: WRK-004 depends on WRK-002 Node evidence
node:sqlite must pass WAL transaction FTS backup restore busy and interruption probes
Fallback is better-sqlite3 only through an explicit decision update; IDE agents may not choose it silently
A project-owned transaction wrapper isolates either binding

decisions.summary: Use a per-agent decision actor plus independent asynchronous behavior leases and global cognition backpressure
consequences: Actor owns decisions and mutations, not duration
Follow returns started plus BehaviorId immediately
Priority control bypasses the ordinary mailbox

decisions.summary: Keep a healthy Mineflayer client connected but enter SUSPENDED whenever the authorized player is absent
consequences: Only presence, connection health, and priority safety/operator control continue
Return is detected only by the still-connected client
Operator shutdown and network/server failure use OFFLINE or DISCONNECTED instead

decisions.summary: Use loopback-isolated offline authentication only for local proof
decisions.source: Reversible safe default for Mineflayer proof without extra account
consequences: Reference proof needs no second account
LAN/WAN exposure is prohibited
Shared hosting requires QST-006 and online mode

decisions.summary: Use deterministic logic for routine embodiment and models only for designated cognitive stimuli
decisions.source: User efficiency requirement and agent-world profile
consequences: Gate-A trigger allowlist is closed
Ambient movement/entity noise never wakes the model
Autonomous idle requires a later measured policy

decisions.summary: Treat speech as a one-attempt runtime delivery workflow, never a physical ActionRequest
consequences: ModelDecision has optional UtteranceProposal
Runtime assigns UtteranceId, persists intent, validates, and attempts once
Unconfirmed send is unknown unless environment supplies definitive deduplication

decisions.summary: Parallax/Lattice persona packages own authored character profile; Agentic-World owns only runtime identity and a versioned profile reference
consequences: DAT-001 becomes CharacterIdentityRecord
Gate A reads one compiled persona artifact through INT-012
Profile mutation remains outside this runtime

decisions.summary: Prove continuity from complete durable events and deterministic encounters before model-authored memory
consequences: Acceptance encounter promotion is deterministic
Summaries and relationship implications remain replaceable interpretations
Natural recall after restart must use retrieved source-grounded context

questions.summary: Which embodiment model boundary and absence behavior define the first proof?
questions.resolution: Mineflayer embodiment; provider-neutral OpenAI-first structured adapter; healthy connected suspension while absent

questions.summary: What is the first NPC's canonical identity voice history values and starting relationship?
What do the owner's LSL scripts and action tags mean and what authority may they have?
Should durable memory or conversation retention differ from local defaults?
What should continue compress or pause while the owner is absent in a later phase?
Will the bot later join a LAN or remote authenticated server with a dedicated account?

questions.source: Prior Parallax/Lattice and persona compiler artifacts
questions.resolution: User-owned Parallax/Lattice persona package is authoritative; Agentic-World stores AgentId plus profile reference/version/hash and reads compiled context through INT-012.

risks.summary: Paper Mineflayer pathfinder Java or Node drift breaks progressive embodiment
risks.source: Current official support ranges differ after Minecraft 1.21.11
risks.mitigation: Re-read primary sources, record exact versions, and pass every SPIKE-000/WRK-002 progressive gate before cognition or persistence.
risks.trigger: Any gate after join fails or integration resumes after dependency/time drift

risks.summary: Model proposes invalid unsafe or impossible action
risks.mitigation: Untrusted typed proposals, closed catalogue, preconditions, limits, and observed results.
risks.trigger: Validation rejection rate exceeds ten percent

risks.summary: Crash or disconnect after dispatch leaves an action or utterance outcome uncertain
risks.source: External world cannot join SQLite transaction
risks.mitigation: Pre-dispatch durable intent, typed unknown state, capability-specific reconciliation, one utterance attempt, and no blind retry.
risks.trigger: Restart finds SUBMITTING, DISPATCHING, DISPATCHED, or ACTIVE without terminal evidence

risks.summary: Model-authored interpretation becomes a false durable memory
risks.mitigation: Persist source events first; deterministic encounter promotion; provenance-or-reject; contradiction/invention fixtures; summaries never replace sources.
risks.trigger: Interpretation lacks visible sources, contradicts invariant facts, or claims certainty beyond evidence

risks.summary: Provider latency or failure breaks conversational cadence
risks.mitigation: LIM-GA-002 remains inside LIM-GA-001, LIM-GA-016 controls retries, context is bounded, and failures are explicit.
risks.trigger: REQ-101 fails in two consecutive live samples or model health becomes unavailable

risks.summary: Prompt/history growth or retrieval failure erodes continuity
risks.mitigation: Gate A uses the fixed retrieval/continuity suite and LIM-GA-018; compaction and semantic retrieval remain measured Gate-B mitigations.
risks.trigger: A release candidate misses the threshold twice after query/index tuning

risks.summary: SQLite binding friction or contention delays proof
risks.mitigation: Pin Node first; prefer node:sqlite only after WAL/transaction/FTS/backup probes; explicit better-sqlite3 fallback/toolchain; short transactions.
risks.trigger: WRK-004 probe fails or write busy errors appear in Gate A

risks.mitigation: Viewer-scoped queries, visibility labels, context manifests, adversarial two-agent gate.
Loopback bind, firewall/LAN probe, authenticated online mode before shared hosting.

risks.summary: Blueprint and code drift after interrupted sessions
risks.mitigation: One implementation-status file, generated registry views, micro-step checkpoints, strict structural validation, and semantic guard.
risks.trigger: Declared paths contracts or statuses disagree with repository evidence

risks.summary: Ambient stimuli or population growth creates uncontrolled model calls
risks.mitigation: Closed Gate-A trigger allowlist, coalescing, pending queue two, suppression telemetry, absence and ambient soak tests.
risks.trigger: Any call occurs while suspended or during the ordinary-event soak

risks.summary: LSL or action tags become an alternate unvalidated action channel
risks.mitigation: Keep QST-003 deferred and require compilation into INT-004 plus threat model.

risks.summary: Competing speech paths duplicate player-visible dialogue
risks.mitigation: DEC-010, one CMP-003 delivery owner, UtteranceId, one attempt, semantic guard banned tokens, duplicate-speech regression.
risks.trigger: More than one submission attempt for an UtteranceId

risks.summary: Lifecycle coupling falsely claims a disconnected client can detect player return
risks.mitigation: Orthogonal connection/availability states; keep healthy client connected during absence; separate disconnect tests.
risks.trigger: Any return transition lacks a READY presence observation

risks.summary: World restore or reset contaminates memories across incompatible history
risks.mitigation: Stable WorldId, monotonic WorldEpoch, epoch-scoped events/encounters, reset confirmation and tests.
risks.trigger: World fingerprint changes without an explicit epoch decision

flows.summary: Start, connect, synchronize, and become ACTIVE or SUSPENDED
steps: Set SYNCING and capture a fresh snapshot
Set ACTIVE only if authorized player is observed; otherwise SUSPENDED

flows.summary: Addressed chat produces one model decision, one utterance attempt, and optional asynchronous action
steps: ModelPort returns one ModelDecision within LIM-GA-002
Persist utterance intent before one independent submission attempt
Dispatch follow and receive started plus BehaviorId within LIM-GA-003
Release cognition run and actor mailbox
Process later BehaviorEvents independently; enqueue later cognition only if interpretation is designated
failure_branches: Rejected action does not block valid utterance
Behavior failure is a later event, never retroactive model success

flows.summary: Fail, interrupt, or remain uncertain honestly
preconditions: A run, attempt, utterance, or behavior exists
steps: Reconcile from a fresh same-epoch observation when possible
failure_branches: World epoch changed -> do not reconcile across epoch

flows.summary: Shutdown, restart, retrieve, and use event-grounded continuity
preconditions: Backup or database integrity is valid
steps: Flush committed events and close runtime/server
On later start create a new WorldSession in the same compatible epoch
Mark unfinished work interrupted/unknown and reconcile
Provide source-labelled encounter context to cognition
Character refers naturally and conservatively to the prior event
failure_branches: No matching encounter -> do not invent recall
Incompatible world -> new epoch and no implicit cross-epoch current-world claim

flows.summary: Model provider degrades without corrupting embodiment
steps: Set model health UNAVAILABLE or DEGRADED
Keep deterministic presence and safety control
Allow later new player stimulus only after health recovers

preconditions: Blueprint bundle and repository are available
steps: Write proving artifact and update implementation status
failure_branches: Missing evidence -> do not infer completion

flows.summary: Suspend on absence and resume only from observed return
steps: Priority-cancel cognition, movement, actions, and behavior
Continue only authorized-player presence observation, connection health, and priority safety/operator control
Observe the same PrincipalId return through the connected adapter
failure_branches: Unexpected link loss -> connection DISCONNECTED and availability SUSPENDED; no return detection claim

preconditions: A behavior may or may not be active
steps: Accept typed control request outside ordinary actor mailbox
Cancel current pathfinder goal and movement controls
failure_branches: Unconfirmed stop -> unknown and operator warning

flows.summary: Run progressive compatibility spike and production pin
steps: Use narrow fallback when a gate fails
Stop before core expansion if embodiment remains red
Copy only the compatibility record and decisions into production
failure_branches: Join-only pass does not retire risk
Failed spike is discarded without damaging prior checkpoint

flows.summary: Reset, restore, and advance WorldEpoch safely
steps: Restore or reset to a separate path first
Keep epoch only for compatible continuation; otherwise allocate next WorldEpoch
failure_branches: Integrity failure -> preserve original and report FAIL
